subject: Flagship Restoration Project in Brazil’s Cerrado Savannah Working to Restore 4.4 Million Acres
posts:
Brazil's Araticum Initiative wins UN recognition as a World Restoration Flagship, aiming to restore 4.4 million acres of the Cerrado savannah by 2030.🌐
Evidence: UN flagships, 50k acres mapped, 150 species
#Environment #Brazil

The Araticum Initiative unites 180+ organizations, indigenous groups, and farmers to restore the Cerrado, combining biodiversity conservation with community development.
